svg.title: Mermaid 架构图：07-skill-evolution
svg.desc: 基于当前 Python 实现的 Skevo 系统设计图。
svg.title: 在线 Skill 演化闭环
svg.desc: 自上而下展示主 Agent 如何在本轮成功回复后建立 pending window，在下一轮开始时消费并追加非空用户反馈，再于下一轮成功结束后异步提取候选，或由 clear 命令清空消息与窗口；也展示 extract_now 的即时路径、Manager 规则修正、写权限、add 与 merge 不同的版本审计顺序，以及并非所有早退和写入异常都能形成 provenance 的实现边界

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: D · 写入权限、版本与审计顺序

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: C · Extractor、参考集与 Manager 规则修正

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: B · 后台与即时入口；共同进入运行 gate

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: A · 跨回合 pending window 生命周期

span.p: 写 log / index 抛异常

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 用户可在下一次 chat 前手动提取

div.style: color: rgb(59, 42, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 👤 主 Agent 收到第 N+1 轮输入

div.style: color: rgb(59, 42, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
clear_history
清空两种 backend 消息历史
与 pending 单槽

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 存在第 N 轮 pending window?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
立即取出并清空单槽 pending
仅当 N+1 原始 user input.strip() 非空时
才追加为 feedback；messages 最多 10 条

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 执行第 N+1 轮 Agent.chat

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
上一窗口成熟
等待后台调度

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
关闭演化协程并返回
不产生 provenance

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: create_task 后 scheduler 立即返回

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ 若已取出旧窗口则该窗口丢失
不调度，也不建立新窗口

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
原始 user input 与
assistant 输出都非空?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
保存新的单槽 pending
最近 user/assistant 消息最多 8 条
latest pair + session_id + 本轮 top reference

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
不保存本轮窗口
下一轮无该窗口可消费

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
后台执行 _run_online_skill_evolution
不阻断第 N+1 轮 chat 收尾

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
/extract_now [hint]
复制当前 pending，await 即时执行
正常返回后清空该 pending

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ❌ 返回 no pending 错误

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
auto evolution 开启、非 Plan Mode、
messages 非空，且 side query / import 可用?

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ ingest 前直接返回
不写 provenance
extract_now 仍报告 ok 并清空窗口

div.style: color: rgb(7, 59, 76) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
◇ Extractor side query
user 为主要证据；assistant 仅作上下文
retrieved reference 仅作 identity context

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
首个 candidate 可被校验?
必需 name / description / instructions
最多保留 1 个；tags 最多 8 个

div.style: color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
现有参考集
discover 当前缓存 Skills；exact identity 比较
name / description / when-to-use
candidate BM25：limit 8，min score 0.03
另带上一轮 top retrieved reference

div.style: color: rgb(7, 59, 76) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
◇ Manager side query
接收 candidate、similar hits、reference
及前 80 个现有 Skill 内容摘要

div.style: color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
确定性规则修正
exact identity 强制 merge
Manager add 且 top score ≥ 0.55 → merge
merge 缺 target 时尝试 top reference
非法 action → discard

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
写门禁基于执行时 permission_mode
后台：仅 bypassPermissions / acceptEdits 自动允许
extract_now：上述模式允许；default 可调用 confirm_fn
dontAsk 拒绝；Plan Mode 已在运行 gate 返回

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
add：create_skill
SKEVO_AUTO_SKILL_TARGET，默认 project
创建 inline、user-invocable=false 的 SKILL.md
frontmatter version = 0.1.0

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
merge：evolve_skill target=active
先写旧内容 snapshot
再 patch +1、last-evolved、evolution-count
写回现有 SKILL.md

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
写 usage.jsonl（lifecycle stats 来源）
add → create event；merge → evolve event
成功后 reset discovery cache

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
❌ 正常错误返回仍保留
action = add / merge，ok = false
例如同名已存在或 merge target 缺失

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
failed
create / evolve / usage 抛异常

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
💾 online provenance 尝试
先追加 online_provenance.jsonl
再按非空 skill 更新 index；merge 成功结果
含 version 并进入 timeline，add 结果不含 version

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
成功 add / merge 后调用 prompt refresh
默认主 Agent 重建 runtime system prompt
custom system prompt 时为 no-op

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ provenance 写入本身未捕获
log append 失败：无 log/index；index 失败：仅有 log
后台 done callback 吞异常；写成功后不再 refresh
extract_now 会抛出且 pending 不执行后续清空

svg.text: 在线 Skill 演化闭环
